ai_summary: Kwai Live 6.0.20.524207 ships the same AI stack as kwai_video/kwai_bulldog (all 14 AI libraries and libCGE are byte-identical; only libcore.so differs). On-device AI is the FaceMagic/westeros effect engine: libFaceMagic.so (beautify, face deform, makeup, bokeh, hair, MMU), libfaceless-plugin.so (FaceMagicController JNI), libfacedetectcontext.so (YCNN face detector), libskwai.so (AR), libvisionengine.so (KVE smart edit/quality/voice detect) and libkwaiaudio.so (Stannis VAD/voice FX). Everything learned is downloaded: 0 model files are bundled, tools/carve_models.py finds no embedded flatbuffer, and YcnnSoLoader loads ycnn/hiai/snpe/tflite_mtk backends at runtime from an external download. The only bundled TFLite model name is voice_detect_mode.tflite (KVE voice detector); libtensorflow-lite.so is a stock TFLite 2.4.1 (NNAPI + XNNPACK, no custom ops) loaded by name. Real shipped parameters (assets/beauty_list presets, assets/BodySlimming/{Filter28p,Filter40p}/*.params) plus the embedded GLSL and the Ghidra-recovered CGE liquify math permitted a runnable JAX reimplementation of the beauty blend and the body-slimming warp (10/10 checks).

features.name: Live beauty (skin smoothing, bright, sharpness, face deform)
pipeline: blur pass (3x3 mean + variance), G3 blend program (skin mask, soften mask, bright LUT, teeth LUT)
GL composite back into the live preview
features.notes: Parameters: assets/beauty_list (5 presets, smoothSkin.beauty/bright, faceDeform, makeup). Shaders recovered verbatim from libFaceMagic.so rodata (evidence/shaders/). Segmentation/landmark models are downloaded, not bundled.

features.name: Face detection and landmarks
pipeline: Bitmap/ByteBuffer -> nativeGetFaceData(w, h, pixels, YCNNResourceConfig, ctx)
features.notes: 26 JNI entry points in libfacedetectcontext.so; model path supplied through YCNNResourceConfig.getYcnnModelPath().

features.name: Portrait segmentation / matting / bokeh
pipeline: segmentation + depth masks uploaded as GL textures (BG_MASK, ORI_MASK, depthTexture)
features.notes: Strings ykit_human_matting_cpu/gpu, human_matting_param, matting_post_texID in libfaceless-plugin.so.

features.name: Body slimming (landmark-driven liquify warp)
entrypoints: com.kwai.video.westeros.models.BodySlimmingAdjustType (WAIST, HIP, BREAST, HEAD, NECK, SHOULDER, LEG, ALL)
pipeline: body keypoints from YCNN human keypoint model
CGE::CGELiquifyFilter mesh warp (forwardDeformMesh, restoreMeshWithPoint, bloatMeshWithPoint, wrinkleMeshWithPoint, restoreMeshWithIntensity)
GL render of the warped mesh
features.notes: Transfer functions recovered from libCGE.so with Ghidra (native/libCGE_liquify.c); op lists use landmark indices up to 62, intensity 0.02..0.6, radius 0.2..1.23.

features.name: Live AR stickers / magic effects
models: skwai instance_model / hair_model / human_key_point_model / human_mesh_model / animal_face_model / ar_hand_pose_model
features.notes: Effect packages and their models are downloaded per sticker/effect; none are in the APK.

features.name: Live audio AI (VAD, voice change, KTV reverb, spatial audio)
pipeline: VAD / active-speaker detection, voice effects, HRTF and KTV model paths
features.notes: Model files are supplied by path at runtime; no audio model is bundled.

features.name: Video quality assessment / smart edit (KVE)
pipeline: libvisionengine.so task pipeline (95 JNI: SmartEditTask, SmartCoverTask, SmartGalleryTask)
features: blocky, blur, colorfulness, defocus, HDR, full-reference
features.notes: demo_vision_feature_response_v2.txt is a captured API response showing the feature set and version=5.

features.name: Voice detection via TFLite (smart cut)
pipeline: AICut downloads voice_detect_mode.tflite into the app cache
EditorKveVoiceDetector native methods (dynamically registered, no Java_* export)
features.notes: voice_detect_mode.tflite / voice_detect_mode_v1 / ks://download_voice_detect_mode are string constants in classes5.dex; EditorKveVoiceDetector declares the native methods and libvisionengine.so looks up com/kwai/kve/VoiceDetectorCallback, so natives are registered at JNI_OnLoad. TFLite is not used by the live beauty/effect path.

reimplementation.limitations: No model weights exist in the APK (0 model assets, no carved flatbuffer, YCNN runtime and models are downloaded), so every learned stage is ARCHITECTURE_ONLY. The runnable stages are the weight-free ones recovered from the binary: (1) the FaceMagic G3 beautify blend transcribed from the embedded GLSL (3x3 mean/variance passes + teeth/bright/clarity/sharpen/skin-blend/LUT), with presets from assets/beauty_list; (2) the body-slimming liquify warp using the CGE::CGELiquifyFilter transfer functions recovered with Ghidra and the op lists from assets/BodySlimming/*.params, applied on a dense displacement field instead of the GPU vertex mesh (equal up to mesh-cell interpolation). Verification is a NumPy cross-check of the same GLSL (max abs err 7.5e-08) plus invariants; it is not a comparison against a device GL render, and masks/landmarks are synthetic stand-ins for the missing YCNN outputs.

data_pipelines.name: Live video: Daenerys camera → westeros GL (face detect + FaceMagic) → Arya RTMP

transport.video: GL texture in the pipeline; YUV ByteBuffer at the encoder tap
transport.capture_config: DaenerysConfigBuilder.defaultCaptureConfigBuilder(): 30 fps, YUV output (kCameraOutputDataTypeYuv=0), size pair y0()=720/v0()=1280, audio 44100/1ch/16bit
transport.encoder_params: nativeSetLiveStreamVideoEncodeParam(w,h,fps,maxBitrate,resumeOnRtcStop); nativeSetLiveStreamRtmpUrl (Arya$AryaConfig.java:1443); defaults 360x640@15fps, kf 4s, min 200 kbps, hwEnc=false
transport.threads: Daenerys native render thread; GlPreProcessor.onDraw on GL thread, post()→nativePostRunnableToGlThread; MediaCallback invoked from the pipeline

preprocessing: Westeros graph bound to Daenerys (nativeSetDaenerys) with WesterosGlProcessor.toDaenerysProcessor()
face detection: FaceDetectorContext registered to Daenerys.X() and Westeros.nativeSetFaceDetectorContext (Westeros.java:341-350)
FaceMagic effect processor from libfaceless-plugin.so on the same frame, results (bokeh mask, memoji icon) returned to Java callbacks
YUV readback for the encoder with downSamplerType from Daenerys.c0()

model.weights_in_apk: none (0 model assets, no carved flatbuffer)

data_pipelines.name: Live audio: mic → Stannis (libkwaiaudio) 3A/VAD/voice-FX → Arya TX
sources: camera-SDK alternative capture: AudioControllerImpl (AudioRecord MIC, 48000/mono/16-bit/10 ms)

transport.format: 16-bit signed PCM (byte[] on JNI; short[] for post-effect/watermark)
transport.channels: 2 for live (AryaAudioEngineProxyImp.java:1159-1161); 1 in camera capture config
transport.sample_rate: runtime: 44100 in DaenerysConfigBuilder capture config; 48000 in AudioControllerImpl default and Stannis.startAudioInnerCap; live TX rate only logged (kAudioTxLiveStreamSampleRate=%d)
transport.device: Oboe/AAudio with OpenSLES fallback inside libkwaiaudio.so ([AndroidAudioEngineOboe] InitRecorder sample_rate=%d, channels=%d, buffer_size=%d)
transport.sync: native audio engine clock; LiveStreamBgmOffsetCb + SpkVocalBgmSyncWorkshop first-frame offset for BGM/KTV

preprocessing: AEC (device preferred, soft fallback) on 10 ms packets: ringbuf_10ms_pkgs / nearend_delay_10ms_pkgs
VAD: SetEnableDeepVad(model) or simple VAD; AudioVadInfoCollector hang_over_ms=500
voice change kVeo* 0-15, reverb kReverb* 0-18, post effect kPostEffect* 0-5 via nativeDspSetParameters/nativeAudioPostEffectSetOption/nativeSetVoiceEffectOption

data_pipelines.name: Live effect/model binding and how it differs from the recorded-video path
sources: Ylab model config: GET /rest/o/production/ycnn/models → YlabModelPathConfig → nativeSetYlabModelPathConfig

transport.effect_package: zip AE2 bundle + assets, passed as byte[] to FaceMagicController.nativeSetEffect(byte[],int,int)/nativeSendEffectCommand, or as a directory path (nativeSetExternalBuiltinPath, ResourceManager.nativeSetPath)
transport.model: paths only over JNI: ResourceManager.nativeSetYlabModelPathConfig(byte[]), nativeSetDirtyLensDetectModelPath, nativeSetFace3DResourcesDir
